description: This Java class 'VerifyPickServices' provides service methods for verifying and completing pick items in a shipment verification process within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for verifying single and bulk items, completing a verified pick, and canceling all verification rows.

classes.name: VerifyPickServices
classes.description: Contains static service methods for shipment pick verification processes.

methods.name: verifySingleItem
methods.description: Verifies a single item in the pick session, creating a row if quantity is provided.

methods.name: verifyBulkItem
methods.description: Verifies multiple items in bulk based on selected map and related item, product, origin, and quantity maps.

methods.name: completeVerifiedPick
methods.description: Completes the pick verification process, returning shipment ID and clearing all rows.

methods.name: cancelAllRows
methods.description: Cancels all verification rows in the current session.
